verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an accounts-payable Bills API for creating and managing vendor invoices, and supplier payments through Transfers and Batch Transfers, which covers bill capture and vendor payment. Nothing in the evidence describes an approval workflow for bills. The only 'approved' mention concerns card expenses, not bills. Missing for 10: documented bill approval workflow/routing rules, evidence of bill upload (e.g. file/OCR ingestion) beyond API creation, an explicit bill-to-payment linkage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
